default_follow_up.title: Follow-up plan
default_follow_up.description: Recommend follow-up within 4-6 weeks or sooner if red flags develop. Document symptom trajectory and adverse events.
actions: Repeat key investigations if symptoms persist
Provide written safety-netting advice to patient

red_flags.name: Severe shortness of breath
red_flags.advice: Advise immediate ED referral / call ambulance

red_flags.name: New severe chest pain
red_flags.advice: Advise immediate ED referral / call ambulance

red_flags.name: New focal neurological deficit
red_flags.advice: Advise immediate ED referral / urgent neuro review

prescription_safety.monitoring: Baseline blood tests where indicated; review liver/renal function before and at 4 weeks
prescription_safety.patient_advice: Stop drug and seek urgent review if severe rash, jaundice, severe bleeding, or shortness of breath
